verdict.line: You lose if you eat free Double Up poke before level 2 and let Strut resets pile up; you win if you save W (Rebuttal) for her Q or R and dump Q (Radiant Volley) plus autos into a landed E (Solar Snare) root.

brief.thesis: Miss Fortune's entire kit runs through projectiles — Double Up and the Bullet Time channel — and Mel's W (Rebuttal) is a hard counter that blocks damage and reflects those exact projectiles back at her. Combined with E (Solar Snare) punishing her for standing still to auto or channel, this is why Mel sits at 51.4% over 500 games here even though Mel is a below-average bot laner overall (45% across 33,352 games) — the matchup, not the champion, is what's favored.

theirWindow.when: levels 1-2, before your E is up
theirWindow.what: Double Up (9s base cooldown, 650 range) hits you and whatever's behind you, and Strut is giving her free movement speed to auto-reset. Play off minion aggro and don't trade face-up until you have Solar Snare.

yourWindow.when: she channels Bullet Time or throws a read-able Double Up
yourWindow.what: Pop W (Rebuttal): it prevents you from taking the damage and reflects the projectile back at her while granting you movement speed. This turns her biggest damage windows into free value for you.

runes.keystoneWhy: Miss Fortune has no dash to dodge it, so every landed Solar Snare root or point-blank Radiant Volley during a trade converts into free Comet damage.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate (80.9%) and win rate (50.6%) combo; Teleport lets you play the level 1-2 disadvantage safely and still reset for plates once Solar Snare and Rebuttal come online.

playing.title: Play passive until level 2
playing.detail: Strut gives her bonus movement speed until she's hit in combat, and Double Up pokes for free before your E exists. Don't contest CS in range of a clean Double Up angle.

playing.title: Bank W for her Q or R
playing.detail: Rebuttal blocks incoming damage and reflects the projectile back at her for the duration. Hold it specifically for a read Double Up or her Bullet Time channel rather than using it on cooldown.

playing.title: Root before you commit
playing.detail: Solar Snare roots at its center and slows/damages the surrounding area on a 11-9s cooldown depending on rank. Land it first, then follow with Radiant Volley and autos so she can't walk out of your damage.

playing.title: Weave abilities into autos
playing.detail: Searing Brilliance grants three bonus projectiles (up to nine) on your next attack after any ability cast. Fire an ability immediately before autoing in extended trades to spike your DPS.

playing.title: Track Overwhelm for the execute
playing.detail: Overwhelm stacks infinitely from your ability and attack damage and executes her once stacks are high enough. Watch her health bar during trades — an E into Q into autos, or a Golden Eclipse, can simply end the fight.

playing.title: Disengage once Impure Shots is active
playing.detail: When she toggles Impure Shots her attack speed rises and her hits cut your healing received. Don't lean on lifesteal or heal sustain in that window — reset the trade instead.

playing.title: Ult through her ultimate
playing.detail: Golden Eclipse strikes every Overwhelm-marked enemy regardless of distance, at a 120-80s cooldown depending on rank. If she's marked and channels Bullet Time in a teamfight, you can punish her from anywhere on the map.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured Mel vs Miss Fortune games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the trade timing, cooldown reads, and mechanical reasoning are my own analysis of the ability kits.
